Above the rooftops of Saigon!
Apr 2024 • Couples
During a visit to the exclusive Diamond Plaza shopping center (in the Lotte complex) diagonally opposite the Notre Dame church in Saigon, we came across various restaurants with a large roof terrace on the top floor.

We opted for the steakhouse with a European twist and were very satisfied.

A clear recommendation!

On to the details.

We were given a table on the large terrace, which was very "sweet" in modern Korean style and had a nice breeze blowing in the early evening.

The staff were very attentive and pleasantly friendly.

The prices are certainly high by Vietnamese standards, but small compared to major European cities. We paid around 85 euros including a tip for our extensive meal.

We had a perfect and delicious salmon tartare (!) with a strong mustard sauce and a Caesar salad that was served with (too much) roasted bacon or ham, but with good dressing and freshness it was really delicious.

For the main course, we had 300 g of steak, medium, perfectly tender and grilled just right, with (presumably McCain) French fries and delicious pepper sauce. 
Also spaghetti with pesto and large crabs (deveined crabs, not a given in Vietnam). The noodles were al dente and the pesto tasted fresh and perfect. 

First we had beer, then a bottle of famous white wine from New Zealand and free water. 

We paid with a credit card, but gave a tip in cash.

Certainly a slightly atypical excursion into a clean, tidy and organized world, but definitely recommended.

It's been a while since the last time I was here. The service was so-so as usual, not the most well-trained staffs. The food was nice but one thing really messed up the place, which was the AC. 

It was too cold and the AC was set on "swing mode". I had to put on a cap while dining. As a result of the AC, the beef got cold really fast. I ordered 200gr and around 60gr left, it was dead cold. So I had to ask the server to reheat it a bit. After coming out from the microwave which took more than 10 minutes, it wasn't rare/medium rare anymore. I was stuck with the medium beef... which was still good though.

4* for Food
Jul 2017 • Solo
I know the restaurant via my colleage. Love the atmosphere and the decoration. I have ordered 1 shrimp soup and 1 chuck flap 300gr, Medium plus mushroom sauce, mash potato and fries.
Good point:
1) The soup was really good taste. It was served with 2 sliced of garlic bread.
2) A portion of beef quite big and above my expectation.
3) Good service for wine, whenever I reordered a glass of wine, the service staff always brought a new glass of water with ice for me.
Need to improve:
1) While enjoy my soup around 5-7 mins, the beef came straight away without any checking from staff eventhough I did not finish the soup. So that I had to have it quickly.
2) As mention at the beginning, I have ordered a beef Medium; however, a half of beef was Rare and a half of beef was perfect Medium
3) I think mashed potato need to add some more milk because the taste of mashed potato was totally pured potato.
To be faired, the restaurant served a nice beef with a good taste of sauce, seasoning and reasonable price. If you are not really care about the service, you should come and try the food to compare with another steakhouse.
Will be back with friend!
